association.title: Association
association.intro: YouCon is the study association for young and future structural engineers.
association.missionText: A network for young structural engineers, where you share knowledge and look beyond your own field.
association.boardText: The board organises the activities and is your first point of contact.
association.historyText: YouCon was founded on 19 November 2009, during the Betondag, by ten young structural engineers.

mission.title: Mission
mission.intro: Why we started YouCon and what we stand for.
story: We didn’t start YouCon on a whim: we believe there is a need for it. It’s good to talk about our profession with other young people and to share experiences with people other than your colleagues. And it’s interesting to look beyond your own field now and then.

We run into each other in the construction process, and although we are all structural engineers, we sometimes don’t understand each other. That’s a shame, because there is a lot you can learn from others.

points.title: A network
points.text: YouCon is a network for young structural engineers, where you get to know your peers in an informal way.

points.title: Sharing knowledge
points.text: YouCon gives young structural engineers a platform to share knowledge and exchange experiences.

points.title: Looking further
points.text: YouCon lets young structural engineers look beyond their own sector, for more understanding of each other. We are there for all structural engineers: consultants, contractors and inspectors, in buildings, infrastructure, geotechnics and research.

points.title: Putting the profession on the map
points.text: YouCon wants to contribute to a positive image of the structural engineer and to structural safety.

mission.ctaText: Come to an excursion or theme evening and get to know your peers. Every young structural engineer is welcome.

history.title: History
history.intro: How YouCon came about in 2009: from a young voice in the Betonvereniging to an association of its own.

moments.title: The initiative
text: In the autumn of 2009, Dick Stoelhorst, then director of the Betonvereniging (the Dutch concrete association), and Raphaël Steenbergen held the first meetings about bringing ‘a young voice to the Betonvereniging’.
In the two months that followed, a group of young structural engineers came together, working in consultancy, contracting, research and inspection, among other fields.

moments.title: The founding
text: YouCon was founded on 19 November 2009, during the Betondag (Concrete Day). At 3 pm, in the BetonverenigingsarenA, the starting signal was given in front of the audience in the stands.

Raphaël Steenbergen gave a short presentation in which he introduced the founders and drew attention to the profession of the structural engineer. Younger members of the Betonvereniging and young structural engineers were invited to join YouCon.

history.foundersIntro: YouCon was founded by ten young structural engineers.
history.todayText: The board carries on the work of the founders, with excursions and theme evenings for young structural engineers.

board.title: Board
board.intro: Seven young structural engineers who run YouCon alongside their work. They organise the excursions and theme evenings and are your first point of contact.
board.groupPhotoAlt: Group photo of the YouCon board

bios.tom: Tom is a BIM structural engineer at BUCC and calls himself a modern structural engineer. He sees construction as a complex puzzle, both technical and non-technical. He is committed to automation, knowledge sharing and simplification, and likes to show what AI can do for structural engineering.
bios.lise: Lise is a structural engineer at IMd Raadgevende Ingenieurs and studied at TU Delft. As secretary she manages the membership records and the mailbox, and makes sure agreements and minutes are written down.
bios.femke: Femke is a structural engineer at Witteveen+Bos and graduated on reusing cast-in-place concrete in new construction. Sustainability and the reuse of materials run through her work. She combines new techniques with traditional knowledge, because physics remains the basis of every structure.
bios.janPeter: Jan-Peter is a bridge engineer at Arup, where he has worked for ten years. He enjoys telling students what it is like to be a structural engineer, for example at the meet & greet at the Dag van de Constructeur.
bios.coen: Coen is a structural engineer at Haskoning and studied at TU Delft.
bios.paul: Paul is a structural engineer at Pieters, growing into a project leader role. With a master's in Building Engineering from TU Delft and an MBA, he combines engineering with management. One of his major projects is De Waaren: the redevelopment of the former V&D building in Leiden, a listed monument that is becoming a place to work, shop and stay.
bios.florine: Florine is a structural engineer at Movares.

partners.title: Study and professional associations
partners.intro: Besides YouCon, there are more associations for structural engineers, each with its own field. Here they are, grouped by material or topic.
partners.lead: Some are very practical, others more theoretical. Most of them are always looking for new members or committee members: a good way to dig deeper into a field and meet engineers from outside your own company.

descriptions.vnconstructeurs: Association that aims to safeguard and further improve the structural quality and safety of buildings and structures.
descriptions.kpcv: Online knowledge base on structural safety, organised by project phase. The digital successor to the Compendium Aanpak Constructieve Veiligheid.
descriptions.betonvereniging: Industry association for knowledge sharing, networking and training in concrete construction.
descriptions.stufib: Study association for structural concrete. Research and lectures for and by its members, from tunnels to high-rise.
descriptions.stubeco: Study association for the execution of concrete structures.
descriptions.bouwenMetStaal: Knowledge organisation for steel in construction, infrastructure and offshore. Publishes the journal Bouwen met Staal and organises events such as the Staalbouwdag and the studentenSTAALprijs.
descriptions.houtconstructeurs: Association for knowledge sharing, networking and training in timber structures.
descriptions.iabse: International association for sharing knowledge and practical experience in structural design.

partners.stufibOffer: One year of free access to Stufib's lectures. Ideal when your YouCon membership ends because you turn 35, but you are welcome sooner too.

privacy.title: Privacy statement
privacy.intro: What personal data YouCon processes through this website, why, and what your rights are.

sections.title: Who we are
text: YouCon is the study association for young structural engineers. YouCon is responsible for processing the personal data collected through this website.
Questions about privacy? Email info@youcon.nu.

sections.title: What data we process
text: When you create or use an account, we store:
list: the company you work at, if you fill it in;
your password, stored encrypted. We can't see it;
the activities you sign up for.

sections.title: Signing in with Google
text: If you sign in with your Google account, Google gives us your name, email address and profile picture. We use your name and email address for your account. We don't use your profile picture. We don't give Google any information about what you do on this website.

sections.title: What we use your data for
text: We only use your data to:
list: manage your account and let you sign in;
keep track of your registrations for site visits and theme evenings, so we know who is coming and whether there are places left;
check with your date of birth whether you are within YouCon's age limit (up to 35);
contact you about activities you have signed up for.

sections.title: Legal basis
text: We process your data because it is needed for your account and your registrations: you ask us to when you create an account or sign up (performance of a contract).
For analytics cookies, the legal basis is your consent. We ask for it beforehand and you can withdraw it at any time.

sections.title: Who can see your data
text: Only the YouCon board and web admin can see accounts and registrations. Other members can't see your data. We don't sell your data or share it for marketing.

sections.title: Parties that help us
text: We use services from others for the website. They only process data on our behalf:
list: Supabase: database and sign-in. The data is stored on servers in Frankfurt (Germany);
Google: if you choose to sign in with Google, and for Google Analytics if you consent to analytics cookies.

sections.title: How long we keep data
text: We keep your data as long as your account exists. Want your account deleted? Email info@youcon.nu and we'll delete your account and registrations.

sections.title: Cookies
text: Necessary cookies: when you sign in, cookies from Supabase keep you signed in. We store your cookie choice for 12 months in the cookie youcon_consent. We don't ask consent for these cookies.

Analytics cookies: only if you consent, we use Google Analytics to measure how the website is used, for example which pages are visited. Google Analytics sets the cookies _ga and _ga_… for this (up to 2 years). Without your consent we don't load Google Analytics. Google processes this data on our behalf and may also process it outside the EU, including in the United States; Google is covered by the EU-US Data Privacy Framework.

Changing your choice: through ‘Cookie settings’ at the bottom of every page you can change your choice or withdraw your consent at any time. If you withdraw your consent, we remove the Google Analytics cookies from your browser.

sections.title: Your rights
text: You may view, correct or delete your data. You may also object to its use or request a copy to take elsewhere. You can change your name, company and date of birth yourself on your account page. For anything else, email info@youcon.nu.
Not happy with how we handle your data? You can file a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).

sections.title: Changes
text: We may update this privacy statement, for example when the website changes. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

cookies.title: Cookies on this website
cookies.text: We use necessary cookies to make the website work. With your consent, we also measure how the website is used, with Google Analytics. You can change your choice at any time through Cookie settings at the bottom of the page.

necessary.title: Necessary
necessary.text: To keep you signed in and remember your cookie choice.

analytics.title: Analytics
analytics.text: Google Analytics shows us how the website is used, for example which pages are visited. Google processes this data on our behalf.
